svg.text: A281 CORNER COST -- the two corner classes F (flat + poker) / T (both tilted), their wall roles Phi / Pi / tau, and the f-table on the window [3.82, s-hat]

Every witness is a set of unit squares verified EXACTLY (rational tilt on the unit circle, SAT gaps >= 0, containment, box / slot incidences strict). Colours: flat blue, poker orange, T-meeter violet; slots yellow, boxes dotted; red dashed = the slot the witness was asked to meet. Grey stipple = undecided. Dead by [T] is written on the panel.
